segments.name: Banking Operations
segments.description: Accepts deposits and borrowings, provides real estate, commercial and consumer lending, makes investments and offers financial advisory services to customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's sole operating segment, Banking Operations, consists of raising funds through deposits and borrowings, providing lending products, making investments and providing financial advisory services to customers.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans and other earning assets, and fee-based businesses generate income for the bank.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest income from loans and other earning assets, and income from fee-based businesses provide banking operation revenue.
